tool_applicability_notes: No promoted Hodge-deformation ResearchTool has authority whose preconditions cover H4d1b.
Kloosterman's flag-Hilbert/Hodge tangent method is retained as a solved-family method transfer, not promoted as a reusable general tool.
Cross-problem tools were not imported without a structural applicability witness.
failure_reuse_notes: F-H4D1A-SAME-DETECTOR-BRANCH-NOGO selects direct δ1-vanishing as the smallest same-detector successor but does not establish that the successor is genuinely simpler.
F-H4D1-DETECTOR-KERNEL-GAP remains a warning that base-side Hodge compatibility alone cannot certify witness lifting unless the geometric obstruction directions are independently controlled.

Difference witness: H4d1b drops detector injectivity and asks about the standard witness obstruction map itself; the repeat-failure test is whether this new condition collapses to the geometric tangent-surjectivity statement it was supposed to explain.
unresolved_warnings: The standard identity ker(δ1)=im(dπ) must be scoped to the exact witness deformation/obstruction sequence; arbitrary obstruction theories need not present this literal linear map.
The geometric image tangent may differ from the tangent of a scheme-theoretic image at singular/nonreduced points; formulate only the first-order image statement actually justified.
A first-order result does not settle higher Artin orders, algebraization, coefficient preservation, monodromy, singular degeneration or global continuation.
H4d1b cannot address initial algebraicity because a central algebraic witness is assumed.
